description: The one runtime policy every DwarfStar model uses. A model file in config/models may override a model_defaults key only with a reason in its override_reasons; repeating a default is rejected.

cache.policy: Splash-m1's symmetric INT8 KV cache (per-token-head F32 scales), 32-token pages, a prefix cache in memory, and long requests' KV spilled to the SSD cache (<cache>/splash-kv)

runtime.engine: Splash-m1 1.6.1-m1 with DwarfStar's patches (splash-m1-1.6.1-ds1): Apple7 Metal kernels, exact BF16 planes
runtime.weights: the split GGUF prepared at start into Metal images; routed experts resident; the PLE table streamed from the SSD
runtime.gpu_offload: full: every layer, the draft model and the vision projector run on the Metal GPU
runtime.speculative: DFlash2 draft model; every drafted token is verified by the target model
runtime.vision: BF16 projector loaded at start and resident
runtime.batch: one model at a time; Splash schedules prefill and decode itself
runtime.telemetry: request metrics and the memory plan from the runtime's /status; no per-token router, PLE or draft detail
runtime.logging: one server log per start in <logs>/<model>/ (newest 10 kept); lifecycle journal <logs>/lifecycle.jsonl

lifecycle.reasoning_change: same model: no restart; the effort is carried per request by the agent's provider file
lifecycle.ownership: the controller records pid, process birth and argv hash; it signals only that exact process

memory.formula: planned = resident model (target weights + draft) + KV cache at the configured context + runtime buffers + vision projector; required = planned + system reserve
memory.metal_working_set: the GPU's recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize, read from Metal on this machine; a model whose plan exceeds it fails at depth even when unified memory is free
memory.switching: a switch stops the running model first, so its planned memory counts as available for the target
